source_review.notes: Checked current Calcite, Spark, Trino, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, and DataFusion planning documentation plus primary Dremel, F1 Query, and Presto architecture sources. All thirteen cited URLs returned HTTP 200. Product behavior is attributed and general planning claims state their semantic and operational assumptions.

evidence: Reviewed logical expression e, schema sigma, snapshot semantics, physical property vector p, delivered properties delta, statistics S, and resource context R.
Reviewed candidate set I, conditional cost C, estimated/actual rows, hash version, key, partition count, and ownership.
Checked equivalence, property satisfaction, minimization, ceilings, modular ownership, and units.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Semantic equivalence and physical-property satisfaction remain distinct relations.

evidence: Executed the Python 3 fixture and reproduced zero local matches before exchange and two matches after repartition.
Verified customer 1 moves to partition 1 and customer 2 to partition 0 under id modulo two.
Recomputed the broadcast example's qualitative multiplication: build bytes are transferred and represented across destinations rather than counted once.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The fixture demonstrates partition-property correctness, not production hash or cost behavior.

evidence: Verified candidate minimization is restricted to semantically equivalent implementations satisfying required properties.
Verified local equality join completeness requires equal keys to meet at one processing partition or an appropriate replicated side.
Verified a replacement subtree may require an enforcer when its delivered properties do not satisfy its parent.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Optimality is correctly qualified by explored alternatives, statistics, cost model, and resource context.

evidence: Reviewed empty inputs, duplicates, null keys, outer joins, unknown predicates, volatility, failures, limits without order, and correlation.
Reviewed zero/high cardinality, stale statistics, heavy hitters, oversized broadcast, partition-count/hash mismatch, spill, and unavailable locality.
Reviewed duplicate attempts, partial exchange, worker loss, adaptive fallback, connector semantic mismatch, and security policy changes.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Semantic, property, cost, recovery, and governance failures are reviewed separately.

evidence: Traced query/session/catalog/security identity through analyzed logical, optimized logical, physical, fragment, stage, task, attempt, and adaptive plans.
Checked operator child requirements and delivered distribution, ordering, grouping, locality, and execution properties.
Checked exchange schemas, ownership, attempt commit, retry, security operators, and lineage preserve observable results.
invariant_checking.notes: Execution lineage distinguishes estimates and proposed plans from actual attempts.

evidence: Reviewed the ten-step audit from analysis through equivalence, physical search, enforcers, fragmentation, execution lineage, and fault testing.
Checked local-join counterexample and co-partitioning sufficiency conditions.
Checked cost-based selection claims remain conditional rather than global runtime proofs.
Audited parse, bind, analyze, logical, optimized logical, physical, fragmented, scheduled, and runtime terminology.
Confirmed exchanges, enforcers, fragments, stages, tasks, attempts, and adaptive replacements are distinct.
Confirmed local/global order and compatible/labeled hash partitioning are not conflated.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Plan representations consistently state their semantic or execution scope.

evidence: Reviewed estimates/actuals, rows, bytes, memory, spill, network, skew, retries, scheduling, and critical path.
Confirmed no universal cost weight, broadcast threshold, partition count, sample rate, or search budget is prescribed.
Confirmed production acceptance requires differential, metamorphic, edge-data, fault, workload, shadow, canary, and rollback evidence.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Plan text and the executable example are not mislabeled production performance evidence.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed lifecycle, SQL semantics, rewrites, memo search, properties/enforcers, scans/pushdown, joins, aggregation, order/windows, estimates/cost, fragments, exchanges, skew, adaptation, security, explain, and validation.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed implementable property contracts, versioned exchange manifests, statistics provenance, search cutoffs, adaptive guards, attempt selection, normalized plan fingerprints, fault injection, canarying, and rollback. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from semantics to physical properties and distributed execution. Ten examples and five answered exercises cover outer joins, hash compatibility, broadcast, aggregates, global order, skew, pushdown, retries, regression diagnosis, executable repartitioning, exchange design, and release validation.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external Calcite/Spark/Trino/PostgreSQL/DuckDB/DataFusion maintainer, Dremel/F1/Presto researcher, query-engine operator, database/performance/platform/SRE/security specialist, affected user, governance or accessibility specialist, or certification review is claimed.
